title: What Domain-Specific AI Models (DSLMs) Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Domain-specific AI models (DSLMs) are language and multimodal models trained deeply on one field — medicine, law, chip design, materials science — instead of shallowly on everything. They trade generality for accuracy, grounding, and smaller size within their domain. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Domain-Specific AI Models (DSLMs): start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Domain-Specific AI Models (DSLMs) in one line: Domain-specific AI models (DSLMs) are language and multimodal models trained deeply on one field — medicine, law, chip design, materials science — instead of shallowly on everything.
Why it matters: A model that knows one field deeply hallucinates less, cites sources, and runs cheaper than a giant generalist..
Where it is used: clinical decision support, legal research, engineering design, scientific literature analysis, financial analysis..
Ladder rank 1 — the foundation. Everything else builds on this.
